title: US Escalates Trade War With Canada
description:
The US escalated its trade war with Canada following Ottawa’s tariff retaliation. Washington moved to block imports of some products while placing new tariffs on others, as well as seeking to bar Canadian companies from selling to government contractors. Bloomberg's Rosalind Mathieson reports.
